title: Sonographic examination to differentiate between peri-implant health, mucositis and peri-implantitis. Prospective 3-year cohort study
summary: The reason for conducting the study is to investigate diagnostic measures on dental implants to differentiate between peri-implant health, mucositis and peri-implantitis. This will be done using ultrasonography, which is a non-invasive, cost-effective, painless and radiation-free method of visualizing hard and soft tissue on teeth and implants. Teeth and implants are clinically examined as part of routine clinical treatment. In addition to the routine treatment, ultrasound measurements are taken on the teeth and implants; a period of 10 minutes is allowed for this. If the dynamic assessment of the degree of inflammation and quantification of tissue perfusion in sonographic images leads to a differentiation between peri-implant health, mucositis and peri-implantitis, ultrasound measurement can be used in routine dental diagnostics.

interventions.name: In the study, 50 patients from the Department of Orofacial Prosthetics and Functional Dentistry at the Medical Center for Dental, Oral and Maxillofacial Medicine in Marburg/Lahn were examined. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Implants and prosthetic restoration
- Implants at least 3 years under load
- Implants without clinical signs of inflammation
- Implants without radiological bone resorption 
- Implants with machined smooth surface, parallel walls and hexagonal external connection (Brånemark Mark II and III, Nobel Biocare Zurich, Switzerland)
- Implants with rough surface, parallel-walled and three-channel internal connection (Nobel Replace, Nobel Biocare Nobel Biocare Zurich, Switzerland) 
- Implants with lengths of 10 to 15 mm and diameters of 3.75 or 5 mm 
- Implants inserted epicrestally 
- Fixed prosthetic restorations (single crowns and bridges)
Patients
- Over 21 years of age at the time of implant placement 
- treated periodontal disease (chronic periodontitis; stage I-II with grade A-C).
- No caries
- no pregnancy
- no current orthodontic treatment
Exclusion criteria:
Systemic diseases (e.g. cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, osteoporosis), untreated caries, pregnancy, current orthodontic treatment, drug and alcohol abuse, regular use of medication, mental illness, smokers.
